description: UPDATES an order — its payment status, fulfillment status, and/or tracking number. This MODIFIES live store data and may trigger customer notifications. Ecwid REST: PUT /orders/{orderNumber}. Provide only the fields you want to change. Returns {updateCount}.

fulfillment_status.description: New fulfillment status: AWAITING_PROCESSING | PROCESSING | SHIPPED | DELIVERED | WILL_NOT_DELIVER | RETURNED | READY_FOR_PICKUP | OUT_FOR_DELIVERY.

payment_status.description: New payment status: AWAITING_PAYMENT | PAID | CANCELLED | REFUNDED | PARTIALLY_REFUNDED | INCOMPLETE.

tracking_number.description: Shipping tracking number to record on the order.

name: ecwid_update_order
title: Update order
